description: Source code for the Playwright Recorder, a component that captures user interactions, manages recording modes, overlays, and communication with browser pages, including event handling, call tracking, and source management.

classes.name: Recorder
classes.description: Main class managing recording sessions, event handling, overlay updates, call tracking, and interaction with browser pages and frames.

methods.name: forContext
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a Recorder instance for a given browser context.

methods.name: existingForContext
methods.description: Retrieves an existing Recorder instance for a given browser context, if any.

methods.name: setMode
methods.description: Sets the current recording mode, updates overlay and debugger state accordingly.

methods.name: pickLocator
methods.description: Enables user to pick a locator on a page, returning the selector.

methods.name: setHighlightedSelector
methods.description: Highlights a specific selector in the overlay.

methods.name: setHighlightedAriaTemplate
methods.description: Highlights an ARIA template in the overlay.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses the debugger on the next statement.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Resumes debugger to close the session.

methods.name: updateCallLog
methods.description: Updates the call log with current call metadata.
